column1: # The frameworks with no module-map header that decls reads from their Headers/ folder (review F29): the umbrella header Headers/<Name>.h
# alone when there is one, else every header of Headers/. Any other framework with no module map is an error. A row is a name, a TAB
# and the reason; a row for a framework that has a module map, or that has no header to read, is an error (decls).
# Measured at the tip (decls over all 293 frameworks, these five listed): exactly these five take the fallback.

column2: no module map; the umbrella header Headers/vImage.h is read and the headers it includes under Headers/ are its own (887 rows, its shard)

no module map and no umbrella header: the 11 headers of Headers/ are read as its public set (299 rows, its shard)
